description.label: Description
description.value:
Major Physical Mutation

You grow four long, spindly legs from out o body that enable you to crawl eortlessly on walls and ceilings. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.wfrp4e-core.items.Item.KII1gWnxIZ8HzmU5]{Wallcarawler} Creature Trait with a movement speed of 5. You also develop a special gland somewhere on your body that enables you to spray a sticky web at your prey. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.wfrp4e-core.items.Item.Bw6tQyzOhcl7aQ46]{Web} (T) Creature Trait with the range of SBx3. You can only gain this mutation once.
